newsitem.title: UK: GEC expected to sign Brunei deal soon.
newsitem.headline: GEC expected to sign Brunei deal soon.

text.p: A contract between Brunei and General Electric Co Plc for the supply of three offshore naval patrol vessels is expected to be finalised "very soon", a spokeswoman at Britain's Defence Ministry said on Thursday.
GEC's GEC-Marine unit were selected for the deal in October last year.
The Ministry said in a statement that the Sultan of Brunei told Defence Secretary Michael Portillo in Brunei on Wednesday that contracts could now be finalised.
Portillo said firms throughout Britain should benefit from the agreement to supply command, weapons and machinery systems for the three vessels.

"The details of the systems selected remain confidential, but the majority will be manufactured in the UK, helping contractors and sub-contractors throughout the nation," he said. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
